latin_ascii: ‘ara valakatira visaya hala, tara pita-mata chila mumina. atahpara ami asamka* karalama ye, se simalamghana o kuphari dvara taderake atistha kare tulave’. * ta~ra asamka nichaka dharana bhittika chila na, varam allahara paksa theke tini niscita janate perechilena.

latin_iast: ‘tāi āmi cāilāma, tādera rava tāderake tāra parivarte emana santāna dāna karavena, ye have tāra ceẏe pavitratāẏa uttama evaṃ daẏāmāẏāẏa adhika ghaniṣṭha.
latin_ascii: ‘tai ami cailama, tadera rava taderake tara parivarte emana santana dana karavena, ye have tara ceye pavitrataya uttama evam dayamayaya adhika ghanistha.

latin_iast: ‘āra prācīraṭira viṣaẏa hala, tā chila śaharera du’jana iẏātīma vālakera evaṃ tāra nice chila tādera guptadhana. āra tādera pitā chila satkarmaparāẏaṇa. tāi āpanāra rava cāilena ye, tārā du’jana prāptavaẏaska haẏe tādera guptadhana vera kare neve. e savai āpanāra ravera rahamata svarūpa. āmi nija theke tā karini. e halo se viṣaẏera vyākhyā, ye samparke āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karate pārenani.
latin_ascii: ‘ara praciratira visaya hala, ta chila saharera du’jana iyatima valakera evam tara nice chila tadera guptadhana. ara tadera pita chila satkarmaparayana. tai apanara rava cailena ye, tara du’jana praptavayaska haye tadera guptadhana vera kare neve. e savai apanara ravera rahamata svarupa. ami nija theke ta karini. e halo se visayera vyakhya, ye samparke apani dhairya dharana karate parenani.

latin_iast: āra tārā tomāke yulakāranāina samparke jijñāsā karache. vala, ‘āmi ekhana tāra samparke tomādera nikaṭa varṇanā dicchi’.
latin_ascii: ara tara tomake yulakaranaina samparke jijnasa karache. vala, ‘ami ekhana tara samparke tomadera nikata varnana dicchi’.

latin_iast: āmi tāke yamīne kartṛtva dāna karechilāma evaṃ savaviṣaẏera upāẏa- upakaraṇa dāna karechilāma.
latin_ascii: ami take yamine kartrtva dana karechilama evam savavisayera upaya- upakarana dana karechilama.

latin_iast: ataḥpara se ekaṭi patha avalamvana karala.
latin_ascii: atahpara se ekati patha avalamvana karala.

latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana se sūryāstera sthāne pau~chala, takhana se sūryake ekaṭi kardamākta pānira jharṇāẏa ḍuvate dekhate pela evaṃ se era kāche ekaṭi jātira dekhā pela. āmi valalāma, ‘he yulakāranāina, tumi tāderake āyāvao dite pāra athavā tādera vyāpāre sadācaraṇao karate pāra’.
latin_ascii: avasese yakhana se suryastera sthane pau~chala, takhana se suryake ekati kardamakta panira jharnaya duvate dekhate pela evam se era kache ekati jatira dekha pela. ami valalama, ‘he yulakaranaina, tumi taderake ayavao dite para athava tadera vyapare sadacaranao karate para’.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘ye vyakti yulama karave, āmi acirei tāke śāsti deva. ataḥpara tāke tāra ravera nikaṭa phiriẏe neẏā have. takhana tini tāke kaṭhina āyāva devena’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ye vyakti yulama karave, ami acirei take sasti deva. atahpara take tara ravera nikata phiriye neya have. takhana tini take kathina ayava devena’.

latin_iast: ‘āra ye vyakti īmāna ānave evaṃ satkāja karave, tāra janya raẏeche uttama puraskāra. āra āmi āmāra vyavahāre tāra sāthe narama kathā valava’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara ye vyakti imana anave evam satkaja karave, tara janya rayeche uttama puraskara. ara ami amara vyavahare tara sathe narama katha valava’.

latin_iast: tārapara se āreka patha avalamvana karala.
latin_ascii: tarapara se areka patha avalamvana karala.

latin_iast: avaśeṣe se yakhana sūryodaẏera sthāne ese pau~chala takhana se dekhate pela, tā emana eka jātira upara udita hacche yādera janya āmi sūryera viparīte kona ār̤ālera vyavasthā karini.
latin_ascii: avasese se yakhana suryodayera sthane ese pau~chala takhana se dekhate pela, ta emana eka jatira upara udita hacche yadera janya ami suryera viparite kona aralera vyavastha karini.

latin_iast: prakṛta ghaṭanā eṭāi. āra tāra nikaṭa yā chila, āmi se samparke sampūrṇa avahita.
latin_ascii: prakrta ghatana etai. ara tara nikata ya chila, ami se samparke sampurna avahita.

latin_iast: tārapara se āreka patha avalamvana karala.
latin_ascii: tarapara se areka patha avalamvana karala.

latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana se dui parvatera madhyavartī sthāne pau~chala, takhana sekhāne se emana eka jātike pela, yārā tāra kathā temana ekaṭā vujhate pārachila nā.
latin_ascii: avasese yakhana se dui parvatera madhyavarti sthane pau~chala, takhana sekhane se emana eka jatike pela, yara tara katha temana ekata vujhate parachila na.

latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘he yulakāranāina! niścaẏa iẏā’jūja o mā’jūja yamīne aśānti sṛṣṭi karache, tāi āmarā ki āpanāke e janya kichu kharaca deva ye, āpani āmādera o tādera madhye ekaṭā prācīra nirmāṇa kare devena’?
latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘he yulakaranaina! niscaya iya’juja o ma’juja yamine asanti srsti karache, tai amara ki apanake e janya kichu kharaca deva ye, apani amadera o tadera madhye ekata pracira nirmana kare devena’y

latin_iast: se valala, ‘āmāra rava āmāke ye sāmarthya diẏechena, seṭāi uttama. sutarāṃ tomarā āmāke śrama diẏe sāhāyya kara. āmi tomādera o tādera mājhakhāne ekaṭi sudṛr̤ha prācīra nirmāṇa kare deva’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘amara rava amake ye samarthya diyechena, setai uttama. sutaram tomara amake srama diye sahayya kara. ami tomadera o tadera majhakhane ekati sudrrha pracira nirmana kare deva’.

latin_iast: ‘tomarā āmāke lohāra pāta ene dāo’. avaśeṣe yakhana se du’pāhār̤era madhyavartī jāẏagā samāna kare dila, takhana se valala, ‘tomarā phu~ka dite thāka’. ataḥpara yakhana se tā āgune pariṇata karala, takhana valala, ‘tomarā āmāke kichu tāmā dāo, āmi tā era upara ḍhele dei’.
latin_ascii: ‘tomara amake lohara pata ene dao’. avasese yakhana se du’paharera madhyavarti jayaga samana kare dila, takhana se valala, ‘tomara phu~ka dite thaka’. atahpara yakhana se ta agune parinata karala, takhana valala, ‘tomara amake kichu tama dao, ami ta era upara dhele dei’.

latin_iast: erapara tārā (iẏā’jūja o mā’jūja) prācīrera upara diẏe atikrama karate pārala nā evaṃ nica diẏeo tā bheda karate pārala nā.
latin_ascii: erapara tara (iya’juja o ma’juja) pracirera upara diye atikrama karate parala na evam nica diyeo ta bheda karate parala na.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘eṭā āmāra ravera anugraha. ataḥpara yakhana āmāra ravera oẏādākṛta samaẏa āsave takhana tini tā māṭira sāthe miśiẏe devena. āra āmāra ravera oẏādā satya’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘eta amara ravera anugraha. atahpara yakhana amara ravera oyadakrta samaya asave takhana tini ta matira sathe misiye devena. ara amara ravera oyada satya’.

latin_iast: āra sedina āmi tāderake emana avasthāẏa cher̤e deva ye, tārā ekadala āreka dalera upara taraṅgamālāra mata āchar̤e par̤ave evaṃ śiṅgāẏa phu~ka deẏā have. ataḥpara āmi tādera sakalake ekatra karava.
latin_ascii: ara sedina ami taderake emana avasthaya chere deva ye, tara ekadala areka dalera upara tarangamalara mata achare parave evam singaya phu~ka deya have. atahpara ami tadera sakalake ekatra karava.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi sedina kāphiradera janya jāhānnāmake sarāsari upasthita karava;
latin_ascii: evam ami sedina kaphiradera janya jahannamake sarasari upasthita karava;

latin_iast: āmāra smaraṇa theke yādera cokha chila āvaraṇe ḍhākā evaṃ yārā śunateo chila akṣama.
latin_ascii: amara smarana theke yadera cokha chila avarane dhaka evam yara sunateo chila aksama.

latin_iast: yārā kupharī karache, tārā ki mane kareche ye, tārā āmāra parivarte āmāra vāndāderake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa karave? niścaẏa āmi jāhānnāmake kāphiradera āpyāẏanera janya prastuta karachi.
latin_ascii: yara kuphari karache, tara ki mane kareche ye, tara amara parivarte amara vandaderake abhibhavakarupe grahana karavey niscaya ami jahannamake kaphiradera apyayanera janya prastuta karachi.

latin_iast: vala, ‘āmi ki tomāderake emana lokadera kathā jānāva, yārā āmalera dika theke savaceẏe veśī kṣatigrasta’?
latin_ascii: vala, ‘ami ki tomaderake emana lokadera katha janava, yara amalera dika theke savaceye vesi ksatigrasta’y

latin_iast: duniẏāra jīvane yādera ceṣṭā vyartha haẏe geche, athaca tārā mane karache ye, tārā bhāla kājai karache’!
latin_ascii: duniyara jivane yadera cesta vyartha haye geche, athaca tara mane karache ye, tara bhala kajai karache’!

latin_iast: ‘tārāi sesava loka, yārā tādera ravera āẏātasamūha evaṃ tā~ra sāthe sākṣātake asvīkāra kareche. phale tādera sakala āmala niṣphala haẏe geche. sutarāṃ āmi tādera janya kiẏāmatera dina kona ojanera vyavasthā rākhava nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘tarai sesava loka, yara tadera ravera ayatasamuha evam ta~ra sathe saksatake asvikara kareche. phale tadera sakala amala nisphala haye geche. sutaram ami tadera janya kiyamatera dina kona ojanera vyavastha rakhava na’.

latin_iast: ‘e janyai tādera pratiphala jāhānnāma. kāraṇa tārā kupharī kareche evaṃ āmāra āẏātasamūha o āmāra rāsūlagaṇake vidrūpera viṣaẏa vāniẏeche’.
latin_ascii: ‘e janyai tadera pratiphala jahannama. karana tara kuphari kareche evam amara ayatasamuha o amara rasulaganake vidrupera visaya vaniyeche’.

latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ satkāja kareche, tādera mehamānadārira janya raẏeche jānnātula pheradāusa.
latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana eneche evam satkaja kareche, tadera mehamanadarira janya rayeche jannatula pheradausa.

latin_iast: sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have. tārā sekhāna theke anya kothāo sthānāntarita hate cāive nā.
latin_ascii: sekhane tara sthayi have. tara sekhana theke anya kothao sthanantarita hate caive na.

latin_iast: vala, ‘āmāra ravera kathā lekhāra janya samudra yadi kāli haẏe yāẏa tave samudra niḥśeṣa haẏe yāve āmāra ravera kathā śeṣa haoẏāra āgei. yadio era sāhāyyārthe anurūpa āro samudra niẏe āsi’.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘amara ravera katha lekhara janya samudra yadi kali haye yaya tave samudra nihsesa haye yave amara ravera katha sesa haoyara agei. yadio era sahayyarthe anurupa aro samudra niye asi’.

latin_iast: vala, ‘āmi tomādera matai ekajana mānuṣa. āmāra nikaṭa ohī preraṇa karā haẏa ye, tomādera ilāhai eka ilāha. sutarāṃ ye tāra ravera sākṣāt kāmanā kare, se yena satkarma kare evaṃ tāra ravera ivādāte kāuke śarīka nā kare’.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘ami tomadera matai ekajana manusa. amara nikata ohi prerana kara haya ye, tomadera ilahai eka ilaha. sutaram ye tara ravera saksat kamana kare, se yena satkarma kare evam tara ravera ivadate kauke sarika na kare’.

latin_iast: kāpha-hā-iẏā-‘āīna-soẏāda.
latin_ascii: kapha-ha-iya-‘aina-soyada.

latin_iast: eṭā tomāra ravera rahamatera vivaraṇa tā~ra vāndā yākāriẏyāra prati.
latin_ascii: eta tomara ravera rahamatera vivarana ta~ra vanda yakariyyara prati.

latin_iast: yakhana se tāra ravake gopane ḍekechila.
latin_ascii: yakhana se tara ravake gopane dekechila.

latin_iast: se valechila, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāra hār̤agulo durvala haẏe geche evaṃ vārdhakyavaśataḥ āmāra māthāra culagulo sādā haẏe geche. he āmāra rava, āpanāra nikaṭa do‘ā kare āmi kakhano vyartha haini’.
latin_ascii: se valechila, ‘he amara rava! amara haragulo durvala haye geche evam vardhakyavasatah amara mathara culagulo sada haye geche. he amara rava, apanara nikata do‘a kare ami kakhano vyartha haini’.

latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra pare svagotrīẏadera samparke āmi āśaṃkāvodha karachi. āmāra strī to vandhyā, ataeva āpani āmāke āpanāra pakṣa theke ekajana uttarādhikārī dāna karuna’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara amara pare svagotriyadera samparke ami asamkavodha karachi. amara stri to vandhya, ataeva apani amake apanara paksa theke ekajana uttaradhikari dana karuna’.

latin_iast: ‘ye āmāra uttarādhikārī have evaṃ iẏākūvera vaṃśera uttarādhikārī have. he āmāra rava, āpani tāke pachandanīẏa vāniẏe dina’.
latin_ascii: ‘ye amara uttaradhikari have evam iyakuvera vamsera uttaradhikari have. he amara rava, apani take pachandaniya vaniye dina’.

latin_iast: (āllāha valalena) ‘he yākāriẏyā, āmi tomāke ekaṭi putra santānera susaṃvāda dicchi, tāra nāma iẏāhaiẏā. itipūrve kāuke āmi e nāma deini’.
latin_ascii: (allaha valalena) ‘he yakariyya, ami tomake ekati putra santanera susamvada dicchi, tara nama iyahaiya. itipurve kauke ami e nama deini’.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘he āmāra rava, kibhāve āmāra putra santāna have, āmāra strī to vandhyā, āra āmio to vārdhakyera śeṣa paryāẏe pau~che giẏechi’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he amara rava, kibhave amara putra santana have, amara stri to vandhya, ara amio to vardhakyera sesa paryaye pau~che giyechi’.

latin_iast: se (phereśatā) valala, ‘ebhāvei’. tomāra rava valechena, ‘eṭā āmāra janya sahaja. āmi to itaḥpūrve tomāke sṛṣṭi karechi, takhana tumi kichui chile nā’.
latin_ascii: se (pheresata) valala, ‘ebhavei’. tomara rava valechena, ‘eta amara janya sahaja. ami to itahpurve tomake srsti karechi, takhana tumi kichui chile na’.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘he āmāra rava, āmāra janya ekaṭi nidarśana ṭhika kare dina’. tini valalena, ‘tomāra janya eṭāi nidarśana ye, tumi sustha thekeo tina rāta kāro sāthe kathā valave nā’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he amara rava, amara janya ekati nidarsana thika kare dina’. tini valalena, ‘tomara janya etai nidarsana ye, tumi sustha thekeo tina rata karo sathe katha valave na’.

latin_iast: ataḥpara se miharāva hate veriẏe tāra lokadera sāmane āsala evaṃ iśārāẏa tāderake valala ye, ‘tomarā sakāla o sandhyāẏa tāsavīha pāṭha kara’.
latin_ascii: atahpara se miharava hate veriye tara lokadera samane asala evam isaraya taderake valala ye, ‘tomara sakala o sandhyaya tasaviha patha kara’.

latin_iast: ‘he iẏāhaiẏā, tumi kitāvaṭike dṛr̤habhāve ā~kar̤e dhara’. āmi tāke śaiśavei prajñā* dāna karechi. * ekhāne ‘hukama’ valate hikamāta vā prajñā vujhāno haẏeche. kāro mate, tā hala ilama o āmala. keu valechena, navuoẏāta vā ākala. imāma śaokānī valena, ullekhita pratiṭi viṣaẏa ‘hukama’ dvārā uddeśya hate pāre.
latin_ascii: ‘he iyahaiya, tumi kitavatike drrhabhave a~kare dhara’. ami take saisavei prajna* dana karechi. * ekhane ‘hukama’ valate hikamata va prajna vujhano hayeche. karo mate, ta hala ilama o amala. keu valechena, navuoyata va akala. imama saokani valena, ullekhita pratiti visaya ‘hukama’ dvara uddesya hate pare.

latin_iast: āra āmāra pakṣa theke tāke sneha-mamatā o pavitratā dāna karechi evaṃ se muttākī chila.
latin_ascii: ara amara paksa theke take sneha-mamata o pavitrata dana karechi evam se muttaki chila.

latin_iast: āra se chila tāra pitā-mātāra sāthe sadācārī, āra chila nā ahaṃkārī, avādhya.
latin_ascii: ara se chila tara pita-matara sathe sadacari, ara chila na ahamkari, avadhya.

latin_iast: āra tāra upara śānti, yedina se janmeche evaṃ yedina se mārā yāve āra yedina tāke jīvita avasthāẏa uṭhāno have.
latin_ascii: ara tara upara santi, yedina se janmeche evam yedina se mara yave ara yedina take jivita avasthaya uthano have.

latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara ei kitāve māraiẏāmake yakhana se tāra parivāravarga theke pṛthaka haẏe pūrva dikera kona eka sthāne cale gela.
latin_ascii: ara smarana kara ei kitave maraiyamake yakhana se tara parivaravarga theke prthaka haye purva dikera kona eka sthane cale gela.

latin_iast: āra se tādera nikaṭa theke (nijake) ār̤āla karala. takhana āmi tāra nikaṭa āmāra rūha (jivarīla) ke preraṇa karalāma. ataḥpara se tāra sāmane pūrṇa mānavera rūpa dhāraṇa karala.
latin_ascii: ara se tadera nikata theke (nijake) arala karala. takhana ami tara nikata amara ruha (jivarila) ke prerana karalama. atahpara se tara samane purna manavera rupa dharana karala.

latin_iast: māraiẏāma valala, ‘āmi tomāra theke parama karuṇāmaẏera āśraẏa cācchi, yadi tumi muttākī hao’.
latin_ascii: maraiyama valala, ‘ami tomara theke parama karunamayera asraya cacchi, yadi tumi muttaki hao’.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘āmi to kevala tomāra ravera vārtāvāhaka, tomāke ekajana pavitra putrasantāna dāna karāra janya esechi’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ami to kevala tomara ravera vartavahaka, tomake ekajana pavitra putrasantana dana karara janya esechi’.

latin_iast: māraiẏāma valala, ‘kibhāve āmāra putra santāna have? athaca kona mānuṣa āmāke sparśa kareni. āra āmi to vyabhicāriṇīo nai’.
latin_ascii: maraiyama valala, ‘kibhave amara putra santana havey athaca kona manusa amake sparsa kareni. ara ami to vyabhicarinio nai’.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘ebhāvei. tomāra rava valechena, eṭā āmāra janya sahaja. āra yena āmi tāke kare dei mānuṣera janya nidarśana evaṃ āmāra pakṣa theke rahamata. āra eṭi ekaṭi siddhāntakṛta viṣaẏa’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ebhavei. tomara rava valechena, eta amara janya sahaja. ara yena ami take kare dei manusera janya nidarsana evam amara paksa theke rahamata. ara eti ekati siddhantakrta visaya’.

latin_iast: tārapara se tāke garbhe dhāraṇa karala evaṃ tā niẏe dūravartī ekaṭi sthāne cale gela.
latin_ascii: tarapara se take garbhe dharana karala evam ta niye duravarti ekati sthane cale gela.

latin_iast: ataḥpara prasava-vedanā tāke khejura gāchera kānḍera kāche niẏe elo. se valala, ‘hāẏa! era āgei yadi āmi mare yetāma evaṃ sampūrṇarūpe vismṛta hatāma’!
latin_ascii: atahpara prasava-vedana take khejura gachera kandera kache niye elo. se valala, ‘haya! era agei yadi ami mare yetama evam sampurnarupe vismrta hatama’!

latin_iast: takhana tāra nica theke se tāke ḍeke valala ye, ‘tumi cintā karo nā. tomāra rava tomāra nice ekaṭi jharṇā sṛṣṭi karechena’.
latin_ascii: takhana tara nica theke se take deke valala ye, ‘tumi cinta karo na. tomara rava tomara nice ekati jharna srsti karechena’.

latin_iast: ‘āra tumi khejura gāchera kānḍa dhare tomāra dike nār̤ā dāo, tāhale tā tomāra upara tājā-pākā khejura phelave’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara tumi khejura gachera kanda dhare tomara dike nara dao, tahale ta tomara upara taja-paka khejura phelave’.

latin_iast: ‘ataḥpara tumi khāo, pāna kara evaṃ cokha jur̤āo. āra yadi tumi kona lokake dekhate pāo tāhale vale dio, ‘āmi parama karuṇāmaẏera janya cupa thākāra mānata karechi. ataeva āja āmi kona mānuṣera sāthe kichutei kathā valava nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘atahpara tumi khao, pana kara evam cokha jurao. ara yadi tumi kona lokake dekhate pao tahale vale dio, ‘ami parama karunamayera janya cupa thakara manata karechi. ataeva aja ami kona manusera sathe kichutei katha valava na’.

latin_iast: tārapara se tāke kole niẏe nija kaomera nikaṭa āsala. tārā valala, ‘he māraiẏāma! tumi to eka adbhūta viṣaẏa niẏe esecha’!
latin_ascii: tarapara se take kole niye nija kaomera nikata asala. tara valala, ‘he maraiyama! tumi to eka adbhuta visaya niye esecha’!

latin_iast: ‘he hārūnera vona! tomāra pitā to khārāpa loka chila nā. āra tomāra mā-o chila nā vyabhicāriṇī’.
latin_ascii: ‘he harunera vona! tomara pita to kharapa loka chila na. ara tomara ma-o chila na vyabhicarini’.

latin_iast: takhana se śiśuṭira dike iśārā karala. tārā valala, ‘ye kolera śiśu āmarā kibhāve tāra sāthe kathā valava’?
latin_ascii: takhana se sisutira dike isara karala. tara valala, ‘ye kolera sisu amara kibhave tara sathe katha valava’y

latin_iast: śiśuṭi valala, ‘āmi to āllāhara vāndā; tini āmāke kitāva diẏechena evaṃ āmāke navī vāniẏechena’.
latin_ascii: sisuti valala, ‘ami to allahara vanda; tini amake kitava diyechena evam amake navi vaniyechena’.

latin_iast: ‘āra yekhānei āmi thāki nā kena tini āmāke varakatamaẏa karechena evaṃ yatadina āmi jīvita thāki tini āmāke sālāta o yākāta ādāẏa karate ādeśa karechena’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara yekhanei ami thaki na kena tini amake varakatamaya karechena evam yatadina ami jivita thaki tini amake salata o yakata adaya karate adesa karechena’.

latin_iast: ‘āra āmāke māẏera prati anugata karechena evaṃ tini āmāke ahaṅkārī, avādhya karenani’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara amake mayera prati anugata karechena evam tini amake ahankari, avadhya karenani’.

latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra upara śānti, yedina āmi janmechi evaṃ yedina āmi mārā yāva āra yedina āmāke jīvita avasthāẏa uṭhāno have’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara amara upara santi, yedina ami janmechi evam yedina ami mara yava ara yedina amake jivita avasthaya uthano have’.

latin_iast: ei hacche māraiẏāma putra īsā. eṭāi saṭhika vaktavya, ye viṣaẏe lokerā sandeha poṣaṇa karache.
latin_ascii: ei hacche maraiyama putra isa. etai sathika vaktavya, ye visaye lokera sandeha posana karache.

latin_iast: santāna grahaṇa karā āllāhara kāja naẏa. tini pavitra-mahāna. tini yakhana kona viṣaẏera siddhānta grahaṇa karena takhana taduddeśye śudhu valena, ‘hao’, amani tā haẏe yāẏa.
latin_ascii: santana grahana kara allahara kaja naya. tini pavitra-mahana. tini yakhana kona visayera siddhanta grahana karena takhana taduddesye sudhu valena, ‘hao’, amani ta haye yaya.

latin_iast: āra niścaẏa āllāha āmāra rava evaṃ tomādera rava. sutarāṃ tomarā tā~ra ivādāta kara. eṭāi sarala patha.
latin_ascii: ara niscaya allaha amara rava evam tomadera rava. sutaram tomara ta~ra ivadata kara. etai sarala patha.

latin_iast: erapara tādera madhya theke vibhinna dala matabheda karala. kājei mahādivasa pratyakṣakāle kāphiradera dhvaṃsa anivārya.
latin_ascii: erapara tadera madhya theke vibhinna dala matabheda karala. kajei mahadivasa pratyaksakale kaphiradera dhvamsa anivarya.

latin_iast: yedina tārā āmāra kāche āsave sedina tārā katai nā spaṣṭabhāve śunate pāve evaṃ dekhate pāve! kintu yālimarā āja spaṣṭa bhraṣṭatāra madhye raẏeche.
latin_ascii: yedina tara amara kache asave sedina tara katai na spastabhave sunate pave evam dekhate pave! kintu yalimara aja spasta bhrastatara madhye rayeche.

latin_iast: āra tāderake satarka kare dāo paritāpa divasa samparke yakhana sava viṣaẏera cūr̤ānta siddhānta haẏe yāve, athaca tārā raẏeche udāsīnatāẏa vibhora evaṃ tārā īmāna ānache nā.
latin_ascii: ara taderake satarka kare dao paritapa divasa samparke yakhana sava visayera curanta siddhanta haye yave, athaca tara rayeche udasinataya vibhora evam tara imana anache na.

latin_iast: niścaẏa āmi yamīna o era upare yā raẏeche tāra cūr̤ānta mālika hava* evaṃ āmārai nikaṭa tādera phiriẏe ānā have. * cūr̤ānta oẏārisa valate vujhāno haẏeche cūr̤ānta mālika arthāt sava kichu dhvaṃsa haẏe yāoẏāra para ekamātra āllāhai thākavena evaṃ savakichu thākave tā~ra mālikānādhīna.
latin_ascii: niscaya ami yamina o era upare ya rayeche tara curanta malika hava* evam amarai nikata tadera phiriye ana have. * curanta oyarisa valate vujhano hayeche curanta malika arthat sava kichu dhvamsa haye yaoyara para ekamatra allahai thakavena evam savakichu thakave ta~ra malikanadhina.

latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara ei kitāve ivarāhīmake. niścaẏa se chila parama satyavādī, navī.
latin_ascii: ara smarana kara ei kitave ivarahimake. niscaya se chila parama satyavadi, navi.

latin_iast: yakhana se tāra pitāke valala, ‘he āmāra pitā, tumi kena tāra ivādāta kara ye nā śunate pāẏa, nā dekhate pāẏa evaṃ nā tomāra kona upakāre āsate pāre’?
latin_ascii: yakhana se tara pitake valala, ‘he amara pita, tumi kena tara ivadata kara ye na sunate paya, na dekhate paya evam na tomara kona upakare asate pare’y

latin_iast: ‘he āmāra pitā! āmāra kāche emana jñāna eseche yā tomāra kāche āseni, sutarāṃ āmāra anusaraṇa kara, tāhale āmi tomāke saṭhika patha dekhāva’.
latin_ascii: ‘he amara pita! amara kache emana jnana eseche ya tomara kache aseni, sutaram amara anusarana kara, tahale ami tomake sathika patha dekhava’.

latin_iast: ‘he āmāra pitā, tumi śaẏatānera ivādāta karo nā. niścaẏa śaẏatāna hala parama karuṇāmaẏera avādhya’.
latin_ascii: ‘he amara pita, tumi sayatanera ivadata karo na. niscaya sayatana hala parama karunamayera avadhya’.

latin_iast: ‘he āmāra pitā, āmi āśaṃkā karachi ye, parama karuṇāmaẏera (pakṣa theke) tomāke āyāva sparśa karave, phale tumi śaẏatānera saṅgī haẏe yāve.’
latin_ascii: ‘he amara pita, ami asamka karachi ye, parama karunamayera (paksa theke) tomake ayava sparsa karave, phale tumi sayatanera sangi haye yave.’

latin_iast: se valala, ‘he ivarāhīma, tumi ki āmāra upāsyadera theke vimukha? yadi tumi virata nā hao, tave avaśyai āmi tomāke pāthara mere hatyā karava. āra tumi ciratare āmāke cher̤e yāo’.* * ivane āvvāsera mate e āẏātera artha hala tumi āmāra kācha theke nirāpade sare yāo. keu keu e āẏātera arthe valechena, ‘tumi āmāra sāthe dīrgha samaẏera janya kathā valave nā’. (āt-tāphasīra āla-muẏāssāra)
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he ivarahima, tumi ki amara upasyadera theke vimukhay yadi tumi virata na hao, tave avasyai ami tomake pathara mere hatya karava. ara tumi ciratare amake chere yao’.* * ivane avvasera mate e ayatera artha hala tumi amara kacha theke nirapade sare yao. keu keu e ayatera arthe valechena, ‘tumi amara sathe dirgha samayera janya katha valave na’. (at-taphasira ala-muyassara)

latin_iast: ivarāhīma valala, ‘tomāra prati sālāma. āmi āmāra ravera kāche tomāra janya kṣamā cāiva. niścaẏa tini āmāra prati var̤ai anugrahaśīla’.
latin_ascii: ivarahima valala, ‘tomara prati salama. ami amara ravera kache tomara janya ksama caiva. niscaya tini amara prati varai anugrahasila’.

latin_iast: ‘āra āmi tomādera o āllāha chār̤ā yādera ivādāta tomarā kara tādera parityāga karachi evaṃ āmi āmāra ravera ivādāta karachi. āśā kari āmāra ravera ivādāta kare āmi vyartha hava nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara ami tomadera o allaha chara yadera ivadata tomara kara tadera parityaga karachi evam ami amara ravera ivadata karachi. asa kari amara ravera ivadata kare ami vyartha hava na’.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana se tāderake evaṃ āllāha chār̤ā yādera tārā ivādāta karata tādera savāike parityāga karala, takhana āmi tāke dāna karalāma isahāka o iẏā‘kūva evaṃ tādera pratyekake navī karalāma.
latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana se taderake evam allaha chara yadera tara ivadata karata tadera savaike parityaga karala, takhana ami take dana karalama isahaka o iya‘kuva evam tadera pratyekake navi karalama.

latin_iast: āra āmi tāderake āmāra anugraha dāna karalāma āra tādera sunāma sukhyātike samucca karalāma.
latin_ascii: ara ami taderake amara anugraha dana karalama ara tadera sunama sukhyatike samucca karalama.

latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara ei kitāve mūsāke. avaśyai se chila manonīta evaṃ se chila rāsūla, navī.
latin_ascii: ara smarana kara ei kitave musake. avasyai se chila manonita evam se chila rasula, navi.

latin_iast: āmi tāke tūra parvatera ḍāna dika theke ḍekechilāma evaṃ antaraṅga ālāpera uddeśye tāke āmāra nikaṭavartī karechilāma.
latin_ascii: ami take tura parvatera dana dika theke dekechilama evam antaranga alapera uddesye take amara nikatavarti karechilama.

latin_iast: āra āmi svīẏa anugrahe tāra janya tāra bhāi hārūnake navīrūpe dāna karalāma.
latin_ascii: ara ami sviya anugrahe tara janya tara bhai harunake navirupe dana karalama.

latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara ei kitāve isamāīlake. se chila satyikārera oẏādā pālanakārī evaṃ se chila rāsūla, navī.
latin_ascii: ara smarana kara ei kitave isamailake. se chila satyikarera oyada palanakari evam se chila rasula, navi.

latin_iast: āra se tāra parivāra-parijanake sālāta o yākātera nirdeśa dita evaṃ se chila tāra ravera santoṣaprāpta.
latin_ascii: ara se tara parivara-parijanake salata o yakatera nirdesa dita evam se chila tara ravera santosaprapta.

latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara ei kitāve idarīsake. se chila parama satyaniṣṭha navī.
latin_ascii: ara smarana kara ei kitave idarisake. se chila parama satyanistha navi.

latin_iast: āra āmi tāke ucca maryādāẏa samunnata karechilāma.
latin_ascii: ara ami take ucca maryadaya samunnata karechilama.

latin_iast: erāi se sava navī, ādama santānera madhya theke yādera upara āllāha anugraha karechena evaṃ yādera āmi nūhera sāthe naukāẏa ārohaṇa kariẏechilāma. āra ivarāhīma o isarāīlera vaṃśodbhūta evaṃ yāderake āmi patha pradarśana karechilāma o manonīta karechilāma. yakhana tādera kāche parama karuṇāmaẏera āẏātasamūha pāṭha karā hata, tārā kā~date kā~date sijadāẏa luṭiẏe par̤ata.[sājadāha]
latin_ascii: erai se sava navi, adama santanera madhya theke yadera upara allaha anugraha karechena evam yadera ami nuhera sathe naukaya arohana kariyechilama. ara ivarahima o isarailera vamsodbhuta evam yaderake ami patha pradarsana karechilama o manonita karechilama. yakhana tadera kache parama karunamayera ayatasamuha patha kara hata, tara ka~date ka~date sijadaya lutiye parata.[sajadaha]

latin_iast: tādera pare āsala emana eka asat vaṃśadhara yārā sālāta vinaṣṭa karala evaṃ kupravṛttira anusaraṇa karala. sutarāṃ śīghrai tārā jāhānnāmera śāsti pratyakṣa karave.
latin_ascii: tadera pare asala emana eka asat vamsadhara yara salata vinasta karala evam kupravrttira anusarana karala. sutaram sighrai tara jahannamera sasti pratyaksa karave.

latin_iast: tave tārā naẏa yārā tāovā kareche, īmāna eneche evaṃ satkarma kareche; tārāi jānnāte praveśa karave evaṃ tādera prati kona yulama karā have nā.
latin_ascii: tave tara naya yara taova kareche, imana eneche evam satkarma kareche; tarai jannate pravesa karave evam tadera prati kona yulama kara have na.

latin_iast: tā cirasthāẏī jānnāta, yāra oẏādā parama karuṇāmaẏa tā~ra vāndādera diẏechena gāẏevera sāthe. niścaẏa tā~ra oẏādākṛta viṣaẏa avaśyambhāvī.
latin_ascii: ta cirasthayi jannata, yara oyada parama karunamaya ta~ra vandadera diyechena gayevera sathe. niscaya ta~ra oyadakrta visaya avasyambhavi.

latin_iast: tārā sekhāne ‘śānti’ chār̤ā kona arthahīna kathā śunave nā evaṃ sekhāne sakāla-sandhyāẏa tādera janya thākave tādera riyka.
latin_ascii: tara sekhane ‘santi’ chara kona arthahina katha sunave na evam sekhane sakala-sandhyaya tadera janya thakave tadera riyka.

latin_iast: sei jānnāta, āmi yāra uttarādhikārī vānāva āmāra vāndādera madhye tāderake yārā muttākī.
latin_ascii: sei jannata, ami yara uttaradhikari vanava amara vandadera madhye taderake yara muttaki.

latin_iast: (jivarīla valala) ‘āra āmarā āpanāra ravera nirdeśa chār̤ā avataraṇa kari nā. yā āmādera sāmane āche, āra yā āche āmādera pichane evaṃ yā raẏeche etadobhaẏera madhye, sava tā~rai mālikānādhīna. āra āpanāra rava bhule yāna nā.
latin_ascii: (jivarila valala) ‘ara amara apanara ravera nirdesa chara avatarana kari na. ya amadera samane ache, ara ya ache amadera pichane evam ya rayeche etadobhayera madhye, sava ta~rai malikanadhina. ara apanara rava bhule yana na.

latin_iast: tini āsamānasamūha, yamīna o etadobhaẏera madhye yā āche tāra rava. sutarāṃ tā~ra ivādāta kara evaṃ tā~rai ivādāte dhairyaśīla thāka. tumi ki tā~ra samatulya kāuke jāna?
latin_ascii: tini asamanasamuha, yamina o etadobhayera madhye ya ache tara rava. sutaram ta~ra ivadata kara evam ta~rai ivadate dhairyasila thaka. tumi ki ta~ra samatulya kauke janay

latin_iast: āra mānuṣa vale, ‘āmāra mṛtyu hale āmāke ki jīvita avasthāẏa utthita karā have?’
latin_ascii: ara manusa vale, ‘amara mrtyu hale amake ki jivita avasthaya utthita kara havey’

latin_iast: mānuṣa ki smaraṇa kare nā ye, āmi tāke pūrve sṛṣṭi karechi athaca se kichui chila nā?
latin_ascii: manusa ki smarana kare na ye, ami take purve srsti karechi athaca se kichui chila nay

latin_iast: ataeva tomāra ravera kasama, āmi avaśyai tāderake o śaẏatānaderake samaveta karava, ataḥpara jāhānnāmera cārapāśe natajānu avasthāẏa tāderake hāyira karava.
latin_ascii: ataeva tomara ravera kasama, ami avasyai taderake o sayatanaderake samaveta karava, atahpara jahannamera carapase natajanu avasthaya taderake hayira karava.

latin_iast: tārapara pratyeka dala theke parama karuṇāmaẏera viruddhe sarvādhika avādhyake āmi ṭene vera karavai.
latin_ascii: tarapara pratyeka dala theke parama karunamayera viruddhe sarvadhika avadhyake ami tene vera karavai.

latin_iast: uparantu āmi sarvādhika bhāla jāni tādera samparke, yārā jāhānnāme dagdhībhūta havāra adhikatara yogya.
latin_ascii: uparantu ami sarvadhika bhala jani tadera samparke, yara jahanname dagdhibhuta havara adhikatara yogya.

latin_iast: āra tomādera pratyekakei tā atikrama karate have, eṭi tomāra ravera cūr̤ānta siddhānta.
latin_ascii: ara tomadera pratyekakei ta atikrama karate have, eti tomara ravera curanta siddhanta.

latin_iast: tārapara āmi ederake mukti deva yārā tākaoẏā avalamvana kareche. āra yālimaderake āmi sekhāne rekhe deva natajānu avasthāẏa.
latin_ascii: tarapara ami ederake mukti deva yara takaoya avalamvana kareche. ara yalimaderake ami sekhane rekhe deva natajanu avasthaya.

latin_iast: āra yakhana tādera kāche āmāra āẏātasamūha suspaṣṭarūpe pāṭha karā haẏa, takhana kāphirarā īmānadāraderake vale, ‘dui dalera madhye konṭi maryādāẏa śreṣṭhatara evaṃ majalisa hiseve uttama?’
latin_ascii: ara yakhana tadera kache amara ayatasamuha suspastarupe patha kara haya, takhana kaphirara imanadaraderake vale, ‘dui dalera madhye konti maryadaya sresthatara evam majalisa hiseve uttamay’

latin_iast: āra tādera pūrve āmi kata prajanma dhvaṃsa kare diẏechi yārā sāja-sarañjāma o vāhyadṛṣṭite śreṣṭha chila!
latin_ascii: ara tadera purve ami kata prajanma dhvamsa kare diyechi yara saja-saranjama o vahyadrstite srestha chila!

latin_iast: vala, ‘ye vibhrāntite raẏeche tāke parama karuṇāmaẏa pracura avakāśa devena, yatakṣaṇa nā tārā ye viṣaẏe tādera pratiśruti deẏā haẏeche tā pratyakṣa karave, cāi tā āyāva hoka athavā kiẏāmata. takhana tārā jānate pārave ke maryādāẏa nikṛṣṭa o dalavale durvala.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘ye vibhrantite rayeche take parama karunamaya pracura avakasa devena, yataksana na tara ye visaye tadera pratisruti deya hayeche ta pratyaksa karave, cai ta ayava hoka athava kiyamata. takhana tara janate parave ke maryadaya nikrsta o dalavale durvala.

latin_iast: āra yārā saṭhika pathe cale āllāha tādera hidāẏāta vṛddhi karena āra sthāẏī satkarmasamūha tomāra ravera kāche puraskāra prāptira dika diẏe śreṣṭha evaṃ pariṇati hiseveo śreṣṭha.
latin_ascii: ara yara sathika pathe cale allaha tadera hidayata vrddhi karena ara sthayi satkarmasamuha tomara ravera kache puraskara praptira dika diye srestha evam parinati hiseveo srestha.

latin_iast: tumi ki sei vyaktike dekhecha* ye āmāra āẏātasamūha asvīkāra kare evaṃ vale, ‘āmāke avaśyai dhana-sampada o santāna-santati deẏā have.’ * ullikhita āẏāta ka’ṭi ‘āsa ivana oẏāẏela samparke nāyila haẏa. tā~ra kāche khāvavāva ivanula ārāta (rā.)era kichu ṛṇa pāonā chila. tā cāite gele se tā pratyākhyāna kare vale,‘āmi yakhana mārā yāva, ataḥpara āvāra jīvita hava takhana tumi āmāra kāche eso. takhano āmāke santāna-santati deẏā have. sekhāna theke tomāra ṛṇa pariśodha karava’.
latin_ascii: tumi ki sei vyaktike dekhecha* ye amara ayatasamuha asvikara kare evam vale, ‘amake avasyai dhana-sampada o santana-santati deya have.’ * ullikhita ayata ka’ti ‘asa ivana oyayela samparke nayila haya. ta~ra kache khavavava ivanula arata (ra.)era kichu rna paona chila. ta caite gele se ta pratyakhyana kare vale,‘ami yakhana mara yava, atahpara avara jivita hava takhana tumi amara kache eso. takhano amake santana-santati deya have. sekhana theke tomara rna parisodha karava’.

latin_iast: se ki gāẏeva samparke avahita haẏeche, nā parama karuṇāmaẏera kācha theke kona pratiśruti grahaṇa kareche?
latin_ascii: se ki gayeva samparke avahita hayeche, na parama karunamayera kacha theke kona pratisruti grahana karechey

latin_iast: kakhano naẏa, se yā vale āmi tā likhe rākhava evaṃ tāra āyāva vār̤ātei thākava.
latin_ascii: kakhano naya, se ya vale ami ta likhe rakhava evam tara ayava varatei thakava.

latin_iast: āra se yā vale āmi tāra adhikārī hava evaṃ āmāra kāche se ekākī āsave.
latin_ascii: ara se ya vale ami tara adhikari hava evam amara kache se ekaki asave.

latin_iast: āra tārā āllāha chār̤ā vahu ‘ilāha’ grahaṇa kareche, yāte orā tādera sāhāyyakārī hate pāre.
latin_ascii: ara tara allaha chara vahu ‘ilaha’ grahana kareche, yate ora tadera sahayyakari hate pare.

latin_iast: kakhano naẏa, erā tādera ivādātera kathā asvīkāra karave evaṃ tādera vipakṣa haẏe yāve.
latin_ascii: kakhano naya, era tadera ivadatera katha asvikara karave evam tadera vipaksa haye yave.

latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya karani ye, āmi kāphiradera janya śaẏatānaderake cher̤e diẏechi; orā tāderake viśeṣabhāve prarocita kare?
latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya karani ye, ami kaphiradera janya sayatanaderake chere diyechi; ora taderake visesabhave prarocita karey

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tādera vyāpāre tumi tār̤āhur̤ā karo nā; āmi to kevala tādera janya nirdhārita kāla gaṇanā karachi,
latin_ascii: sutaram tadera vyapare tumi tarahura karo na; ami to kevala tadera janya nirdharita kala ganana karachi,

latin_iast: yedina parama karuṇāmaẏera nikaṭa muttākīderake sammānita mehamānarūpe samaveta karava,
latin_ascii: yedina parama karunamayera nikata muttakiderake sammanita mehamanarupe samaveta karava,

latin_iast: āra aparādhīderake tṛṣṇārta avasthāẏa jāhānnāmera dike hā~kiẏe niẏe yāva.
latin_ascii: ara aparadhiderake trsnarta avasthaya jahannamera dike ha~kiye niye yava.

latin_iast: yārā parama karuṇāmaẏera kācha theke pratiśruti niẏeche tārā chār̤ā anya keu supāriśa karāra kṣamatā rākhave nā.
latin_ascii: yara parama karunamayera kacha theke pratisruti niyeche tara chara anya keu suparisa karara ksamata rakhave na.

latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘parama karuṇāmaẏa santāna grahaṇa karechena.’
latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘parama karunamaya santana grahana karechena.’

latin_iast: avaśyai tomarā eka jaghanya viṣaẏera avatāraṇā karecha.
latin_ascii: avasyai tomara eka jaghanya visayera avatarana karecha.

latin_iast: ete āsamānasamūha pheṭe par̤āra, yamīna vidīrṇa haoẏāra evaṃ pāhār̤asamūha cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haẏe par̤e yāoẏāra upakrama have.
latin_ascii: ete asamanasamuha phete parara, yamina vidirna haoyara evam paharasamuha curna-vicurna haye pare yaoyara upakrama have.

latin_iast: kāraṇa tārā parama karuṇāmaẏera santāna āche vale dāvī kare.
latin_ascii: karana tara parama karunamayera santana ache vale davi kare.

latin_iast: athaca santāna grahaṇa karā parama karuṇāmaẏera janya śobhanīẏa naẏa.
latin_ascii: athaca santana grahana kara parama karunamayera janya sobhaniya naya.

latin_iast: āsamāna o yamīne emana keu nei, ye vāndā hiseve parama karuṇāmaẏera kāche hāyira have nā.
latin_ascii: asamana o yamine emana keu nei, ye vanda hiseve parama karunamayera kache hayira have na.

latin_iast: tini tādera saṃkhyā jānena evaṃ tāderake yathāyathabhāve gaṇanā kare rekhechena.
latin_ascii: tini tadera samkhya janena evam taderake yathayathabhave ganana kare rekhechena.

latin_iast: āra kiẏāmatera dina tādera sakalei tā~ra kāche āsave ekākī.
latin_ascii: ara kiyamatera dina tadera sakalei ta~ra kache asave ekaki.

latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna āne evaṃ sat kāja kare parama karuṇāmaẏa avaśyai tādera janya (vāndādera hṛdaẏe) bhālavāsā sṛṣṭi karavena.
latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana ane evam sat kaja kare parama karunamaya avasyai tadera janya (vandadera hrdaye) bhalavasa srsti karavena.

latin_iast: āra āmi to tomāra bhāṣāẏa kuraānake sahaja kare diẏechi, yāte tumi era dvārā muttākīderake susaṃvāda dite pāra evaṃ kalahapriẏa kaomake tadvārā satarka karate pāra.
latin_ascii: ara ami to tomara bhasaya kuraanake sahaja kare diyechi, yate tumi era dvara muttakiderake susamvada dite para evam kalahapriya kaomake tadvara satarka karate para.

latin_iast: āra tādera pūrve kata prajanmake āmi dhvaṃsa karechi! tumi ki tādera kāuke dekhate pāo, kiṃvā śunate pāo tādera kona kṣīṇa āoẏāja?
latin_ascii: ara tadera purve kata prajanmake ami dhvamsa karechi! tumi ki tadera kauke dekhate pao, kimva sunate pao tadera kona ksina aoyajay

latin_iast: tva-hā
latin_ascii: tva-ha

latin_iast: āmi tomāra prati āla-kuraāna ejanya nāyila karini ye, tumi durbhoga pohāve
latin_ascii: ami tomara prati ala-kuraana ejanya nayila karini ye, tumi durbhoga pohave

latin_iast: varaṃ ye bhaẏa kare tāra janya upadeśa svarūpa.
latin_ascii: varam ye bhaya kare tara janya upadesa svarupa.

latin_iast: yini yamīna o suucca āsamānasamūha sṛṣṭi karechena tā~ra nikaṭa theke avatīrṇa.
latin_ascii: yini yamina o suucca asamanasamuha srsti karechena ta~ra nikata theke avatirna.

latin_iast: parama karuṇāmaẏa āraśera opara uṭhechena* . * e āẏāte āllāhara ekaṭi kriẏāvācaka guṇa sāvyasta karā haẏeche. seṭi hacche astwa vā āraśera upara uṭhā. imāma mālekake e guṇa samparke jijñāsā karā hale tini valena, astwa era artha jānā āche. tave tāra dharana (kyfyt) jānā nei. era prati īmāna rākhā oẏājiva evaṃ dharana samparke jijñāsā karā vidaāta. e nītiṭi āllāhara sakala guṇera kṣetre prayojya.
latin_ascii: parama karunamaya arasera opara uthechena* . * e ayate allahara ekati kriyavacaka guna savyasta kara hayeche. seti hacche astwa va arasera upara utha. imama malekake e guna samparke jijnasa kara hale tini valena, astwa era artha jana ache. tave tara dharana (kyfyt) jana nei. era prati imana rakha oyajiva evam dharana samparke jijnasa kara vidaata. e nititi allahara sakala gunera ksetre prayojya.

latin_iast: yā āche āsamānasamūha, yamīna o e du’ẏera madhyavartī sthāne evaṃ yā āche māṭira nice sava tā~rai.
latin_ascii: ya ache asamanasamuha, yamina o e du’yera madhyavarti sthane evam ya ache matira nice sava ta~rai.

latin_iast: āra yadi tumi uccasvare kathā vala tave tini gopana o ati gopana viṣaẏa jānena.
latin_ascii: ara yadi tumi uccasvare katha vala tave tini gopana o ati gopana visaya janena.

latin_iast: āllāha, tini chār̤ā kona (satya) ilāha nei; sundara nāmasamūha tā~rai.
latin_ascii: allaha, tini chara kona (satya) ilaha nei; sundara namasamuha ta~rai.

latin_iast: āra tomāra kāche ki mūsāra kathā pau~cheche?
latin_ascii: ara tomara kache ki musara katha pau~chechey

latin_iast: yakhana se āguna dekhala, takhana nija parivārake valala, ‘tomarā apekṣā kara, āmi āguna dekhate peẏechi, āśā kari āmi tomādera janya tā theke kichu jvalanta āṅgāra niẏe āsate pārava athavā āgunera nikaṭa pathanirdeśa pāva.’
latin_ascii: yakhana se aguna dekhala, takhana nija parivarake valala, ‘tomara apeksa kara, ami aguna dekhate peyechi, asa kari ami tomadera janya ta theke kichu jvalanta angara niye asate parava athava agunera nikata pathanirdesa pava.’

latin_iast: yakhana se āgunera kāche āsala takhana tāke āhavāna karā hala, ‘he mūsā’
latin_ascii: yakhana se agunera kache asala takhana take ahavana kara hala, ‘he musa’

latin_iast: niścaẏa āmi tomāra rava; sutarāṃ tomāra jutā jor̤ā khule phela, niścaẏa tumi pavitra ‘tuoẏā’ upatyakāẏa raẏecha’.
latin_ascii: niscaya ami tomara rava; sutaram tomara juta jora khule phela, niscaya tumi pavitra ‘tuoya’ upatyakaya rayecha’.

latin_iast: ‘āra āmi tomāke manonīta karechi, sutarāṃ yā ohīrūpe pāṭhāno hacche tā manoyoga diẏe śuna’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara ami tomake manonita karechi, sutaram ya ohirupe pathano hacche ta manoyoga diye suna’.

latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa āmi āllāha, āmi chār̤ā kona (satya) ilāha nei; sutarāṃ āmāra ivādāta kara evaṃ āmāra smaraṇārthe sālāta kāẏema kara’.
latin_ascii: ‘niscaya ami allaha, ami chara kona (satya) ilaha nei; sutaram amara ivadata kara evam amara smaranarthe salata kayema kara’.

latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa kiẏāmata āsave; āmi tā gopana rākhate cāi yāte pratyekake svīẏa ceṣṭā-sādhanā anuyāẏī pratidāna deẏā yāẏa’.
latin_ascii: ‘niscaya kiyamata asave; ami ta gopana rakhate cai yate pratyekake sviya cesta-sadhana anuyayi pratidana deya yaya’.

latin_iast: ataeva ye vyakti tāra prati īmāna rākhe nā evaṃ svīẏa pravṛttira anusaraṇa kare se yena kichutei tāte īmāna ānaẏane tomāke vādhā dite nā pāre; anyathāẏa tumi dhvaṃsa haẏe yāve.
latin_ascii: ataeva ye vyakti tara prati imana rakhe na evam sviya pravrttira anusarana kare se yena kichutei tate imana anayane tomake vadha dite na pare; anyathaya tumi dhvamsa haye yave.

latin_iast: āra ‘he mūsā, tomāra ḍāna hāte oṭā ki’?
latin_ascii: ara ‘he musa, tomara dana hate ota ki’y

latin_iast: se valala, ‘eṭi āmāra lāṭhi; āmi era opara bhara kari, eṭi diẏe āmi āmāra meṣapālera janya gāchera pātā pār̤i evaṃ eṭi āmāra āro aneka kāje lāge.’
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘eti amara lathi; ami era opara bhara kari, eti diye ami amara mesapalera janya gachera pata pari evam eti amara aro aneka kaje lage.’

latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he mūsā! oṭā phele dāo.’
latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he musa! ota phele dao.’

latin_iast: ataḥpara se tā phele dila; amani tā sāpa haẏe chuṭate lāgala.
latin_ascii: atahpara se ta phele dila; amani ta sapa haye chutate lagala.

latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘oṭā dhara evaṃ bhaẏa karo nā, āmi oke ora pūrvera avasthāẏa phiriẏe deva’.
latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘ota dhara evam bhaya karo na, ami oke ora purvera avasthaya phiriye deva’.

latin_iast: ‘āra tomāra hāta tomāra vagalera sāthe milāo, tāhale tā ujjvala haẏe veriẏe āsave konarūpa truṭi chār̤ā; ārekaṭi nidarśanarūpe’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara tomara hata tomara vagalera sathe milao, tahale ta ujjvala haye veriye asave konarupa truti chara; arekati nidarsanarupe’.

latin_iast: eṭā ejanya ye, āmi tomāke āmāra var̤a var̤a nidarśanasamūhera kichu dekhāva.
latin_ascii: eta ejanya ye, ami tomake amara vara vara nidarsanasamuhera kichu dekhava.

latin_iast: ‘phira‘āunera kāche yāo; niścaẏa se sīmālaṅghana kareche’.
latin_ascii: ‘phira‘aunera kache yao; niscaya se simalanghana kareche’.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘he āmāra rava, āmāra vuka praśasta kare dina’
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he amara rava, amara vuka prasasta kare dina’

latin_iast: ‘evaṃ āmāra kāja sahaja kare dina,
latin_ascii: ‘evam amara kaja sahaja kare dina,

latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra jihavāra jar̤atā dūra kare dina-
latin_ascii: ‘ara amara jihavara jarata dura kare dina-

latin_iast: yāte tārā āmāra kathā vujhate pāre’.
latin_ascii: yate tara amara katha vujhate pare’.

latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra parivāra theke āmāra janya ekajana sāhāyyakārī nirdhāraṇa kare dina.
latin_ascii: ‘ara amara parivara theke amara janya ekajana sahayyakari nirdharana kare dina.

latin_iast: āmāra bhāi hārūnake’
latin_ascii: amara bhai harunake’

latin_iast: ‘tāra dvārā āmāra śakti sudṛr̤ha karuna
latin_ascii: ‘tara dvara amara sakti sudrrha karuna

latin_iast: evaṃ tāke āmāra kāje śarīka karuna’.
latin_ascii: evam take amara kaje sarika karuna’.

latin_iast: ‘yāte āmarā veśī kare āpanāra tāsavīha pāṭha karate pāri’,
latin_ascii: ‘yate amara vesi kare apanara tasaviha patha karate pari’,

latin_iast: evaṃ adhika parimāṇe āpanāke smaraṇa karate pāri.
latin_ascii: evam adhika parimane apanake smarana karate pari.

latin_iast: ‘āpanii to āmādera samyaka draṣṭā’.
latin_ascii: ‘apanii to amadera samyaka drasta’.

latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he mūsā, tumi yā ceẏecha tā tomāke deẏā hala’.
latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he musa, tumi ya ceyecha ta tomake deya hala’.

latin_iast: ‘āra āmi āro ekavāra tomāra prati anugraha karechilāma’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara ami aro ekavara tomara prati anugraha karechilama’.

latin_iast: ‘yakhana āmi tomāra mātāke jāniẏe diẏechilāma yā jānāvāra chila,
latin_ascii: ‘yakhana ami tomara matake janiye diyechilama ya janavara chila,

latin_iast: ‘ye, tumi tā~ke sindhukera madhye rekhe dāo. tārapara tā dariẏāẏa bhāsiẏe dāo. yena dariẏā tāke tīre ṭhele deẏa. phale tāke āmāra śatru o tāra śatru niẏe neve. āra āmi āmāra pakṣa theke tomāra prati bhālavāsā ḍhele diẏechilāma, yāte tumi āmāra cokhera sāmane pratipālita hao’.
latin_ascii: ‘ye, tumi ta~ke sindhukera madhye rekhe dao. tarapara ta dariyaya bhasiye dao. yena dariya take tire thele deya. phale take amara satru o tara satru niye neve. ara ami amara paksa theke tomara prati bhalavasa dhele diyechilama, yate tumi amara cokhera samane pratipalita hao’.

latin_iast: yakhana tomāra vona (sindukera sāthe sāthe) calachila. ataḥpara se giẏe valala, ‘āmi ki tomāderake emana ekajanera sandhāna deva, ye era dāẏitvabhāra nite pārave’? ataḥpara āmi tomāke tomāra māẏera nikaṭa phiriẏe dilāma; yāte tāra cokha jur̤āẏa evaṃ se duḥkha nā pāẏa. āra tumi eka vyaktike hatyā karechile. takhana āmi tomāke mānovedanā theke mukti dilāma evaṃ tomāke āmi vibhinnabhāve parīkṣā karechi. ataḥpara tumi kaẏeka vachara mādaiẏānavāsīdera madhye avasthāna karecha. he mūsā, tārapara nirdhārita samaẏe tumi ese upasthita hale’.
latin_ascii: yakhana tomara vona (sindukera sathe sathe) calachila. atahpara se giye valala, ‘ami ki tomaderake emana ekajanera sandhana deva, ye era dayitvabhara nite parave’y atahpara ami tomake tomara mayera nikata phiriye dilama; yate tara cokha juraya evam se duhkha na paya. ara tumi eka vyaktike hatya karechile. takhana ami tomake manovedana theke mukti dilama evam tomake ami vibhinnabhave pariksa karechi. atahpara tumi kayeka vachara madaiyanavasidera madhye avasthana karecha. he musa, tarapara nirdharita samaye tumi ese upasthita hale’.

latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tomāke āmāra nijera janya manonīta karechi.
latin_ascii: evam ami tomake amara nijera janya manonita karechi.

latin_iast: tumi o tomāra bhāi āmāra āẏātasamūha niẏe yāo evaṃ āmāke smaraṇa karāra kṣetre konarūpa alasatā karo nā.
latin_ascii: tumi o tomara bhai amara ayatasamuha niye yao evam amake smarana karara ksetre konarupa alasata karo na.

latin_iast: tomarā du’jana phira‘āunera nikaṭa yāo, kenanā se to sīmālaṃghana kareche.
latin_ascii: tomara du’jana phira‘aunera nikata yao, kenana se to simalamghana kareche.

latin_iast: tomarā tāra sāthe narama kathā valave. haẏatovā se upadeśa grahaṇa karave athavā bhaẏa karave.
latin_ascii: tomara tara sathe narama katha valave. hayatova se upadesa grahana karave athava bhaya karave.

latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘he āmādera rava, āmarā to āśaṃkā karachi ye, se āmādera upara vār̤āvār̤i karave athavā sīmālaṅghana karave’.
latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘he amadera rava, amara to asamka karachi ye, se amadera upara varavari karave athava simalanghana karave’.

latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘tomarā bhaẏa karo nā. āmi to tomādera sāthei āchi. āmi savakichu śuni o dekhi’.
latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘tomara bhaya karo na. ami to tomadera sathei achi. ami savakichu suni o dekhi’.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ tomarā du’jana tāra kāche yāo ataḥpara vala, ‘āmarā tomāra ravera du’jana rāsūla. sutarāṃ tumi vanī isarāīlake āmādera sāthe yete dāo evaṃ tāderake niryātana karo nā. āmarā tomāra kāche esechi tomāra ravera āẏāta niẏe. āra yārā sat patha anusaraṇa kare, tādera prati śānti’.
latin_ascii: sutaram tomara du’jana tara kache yao atahpara vala, ‘amara tomara ravera du’jana rasula. sutaram tumi vani isarailake amadera sathe yete dao evam taderake niryatana karo na. amara tomara kache esechi tomara ravera ayata niye. ara yara sat patha anusarana kare, tadera prati santi’.

latin_iast: niścaẏa āmādera nikaṭa ohī preraṇa karā haẏeche ye, āyāvato tāra janya, ye mithyā āropa kare evaṃ mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
latin_ascii: niscaya amadera nikata ohi prerana kara hayeche ye, ayavato tara janya, ye mithya aropa kare evam mukha phiriye neya.

latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala, ‘he mūsā, tāhale ke tomādera rava’?
latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala, ‘he musa, tahale ke tomadera rava’y

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘āmādera rava tini, yini sakala vastuke tāra ākṛti dāna karechena, ataḥpara saṭhika patha nirdeśa karechena’.
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘amadera rava tini, yini sakala vastuke tara akrti dana karechena, atahpara sathika patha nirdesa karechena’.

latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala, ‘tāhale atīta yugera lokadera avasthā kī’?
latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala, ‘tahale atita yugera lokadera avastha ki’y

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘era jñāna āmāra ravera nikaṭa kitāve āche. āmāra rava vibhrānta hana nā evaṃ bhuleo yāna nā’.
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘era jnana amara ravera nikata kitave ache. amara rava vibhranta hana na evam bhuleo yana na’.

latin_iast: ‘yini tomādera janya yamīnake vichānā vāniẏechena evaṃ tāte tomādera janya calāra patha kare diẏechena. āra āsamāna theke tini pāni varṣaṇa karena’; ataḥpara tā diẏe āmi vibhinna prakārera udbhida utpanna kari.
latin_ascii: ‘yini tomadera janya yaminake vichana vaniyechena evam tate tomadera janya calara patha kare diyechena. ara asamana theke tini pani varsana karena’; atahpara ta diye ami vibhinna prakarera udbhida utpanna kari.

latin_iast: tomarā nijerā khāo evaṃ tomādera gavādi paśu carāo. avaśyai ete vivekasampanna lokadera janya nidarśana raẏeche.
latin_ascii: tomara nijera khao evam tomadera gavadi pasu carao. avasyai ete vivekasampanna lokadera janya nidarsana rayeche.

latin_iast: māṭi thekei āmi tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechi, māṭitei āmi tomāderake phiriẏe neva evaṃ māṭi thekei tomāderake punarāẏa vera kare ānava.
latin_ascii: mati thekei ami tomaderake srsti karechi, matitei ami tomaderake phiriye neva evam mati thekei tomaderake punaraya vera kare anava.

latin_iast: āmi tāke āmāra sakala nidarśana dekhiẏechilāma, kintu se mithyā āropa kareche evaṃ amānya kareche.
latin_ascii: ami take amara sakala nidarsana dekhiyechilama, kintu se mithya aropa kareche evam amanya kareche.

latin_iast: se valala, ‘he mūsā, tumi ki āmādera kāche ejanya esecha ye, tomāra yādura dvārā āmāderake āmādera deśa theke vera kare deve’?
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he musa, tumi ki amadera kache ejanya esecha ye, tomara yadura dvara amaderake amadera desa theke vera kare deve’y

latin_iast: ‘tāhale āmarā avaśyai tomāra nikaṭa anurūpa yādu niẏe āsava. sutarāṃ ekaṭā madhyavartī sthāne āmādera o tomāra milita haoẏāra janya ekaṭi samaẏa nirdhāraṇa kara, yā āmarāo laṅghana karava nā, tumio karave nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘tahale amara avasyai tomara nikata anurupa yadu niye asava. sutaram ekata madhyavarti sthane amadera o tomara milita haoyara janya ekati samaya nirdharana kara, ya amarao langhana karava na, tumio karave na’.

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘tomādera nirdhārita samaẏa hala utsavera dina. āra sedina pūrvāhnei yena lokajanake samaveta karā haẏa’.
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘tomadera nirdharita samaya hala utsavera dina. ara sedina purvahnei yena lokajanake samaveta kara haya’.

latin_iast: ataḥpara phira‘āuna uṭhe gela. tārapara se tāra kauśala ekatra karala, tārapara se āsala.
latin_ascii: atahpara phira‘auna uthe gela. tarapara se tara kausala ekatra karala, tarapara se asala.

latin_iast: mūsā tāderake valala, ‘tomādera durbhāgya! tomarā āllāhara prati mithyā āropa karo nā. karale tini āyāva dvārā tomāderake samūle dhvaṃsa kare devena. āra ye vyakti mithyā āropa kare, se-i vyartha haẏa.
latin_ascii: musa taderake valala, ‘tomadera durbhagya! tomara allahara prati mithya aropa karo na. karale tini ayava dvara tomaderake samule dhvamsa kare devena. ara ye vyakti mithya aropa kare, se-i vyartha haya.

latin_iast: takhana tārā nijadera madhye tādera karma samvandhe vāka-vitanḍā karala evaṃ tārā gopane parāmarśa karala.
latin_ascii: takhana tara nijadera madhye tadera karma samvandhe vaka-vitanda karala evam tara gopane paramarsa karala.

latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘e du’jana avaśyai yādukara. tārā cāẏa tādera yādura mādhyame tomāderake tomādera deśa theke vera kare dite evaṃ tomādera utkṛṣṭa jīvana paddhati dhvaṃsa kare dite’.
latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘e du’jana avasyai yadukara. tara caya tadera yadura madhyame tomaderake tomadera desa theke vera kare dite evam tomadera utkrsta jivana paddhati dhvamsa kare dite’.

latin_iast: ‘kājei tomarā tomādera kalā-kauśala jamā kara. tārapara tomarā savāi sārivaddhabhāve āsa. āra āja ye vijaẏī have, se-i saphala have’.
latin_ascii: ‘kajei tomara tomadera kala-kausala jama kara. tarapara tomara savai sarivaddhabhave asa. ara aja ye vijayi have, se-i saphala have’.

latin_iast: tārā valala, he mūsā, haẏa tumi nikṣepa kara, nā haẏa āmarāi prathame nikṣepa kari.
latin_ascii: tara valala, he musa, haya tumi niksepa kara, na haya amarai prathame niksepa kari.

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘varaṃ tomarāi nikṣepa kara. ataḥpara tādera yādura prabhāve mūsāra kāche mane hala yena tādera raśi o lāṭhigulo chuṭochuṭi karache.
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘varam tomarai niksepa kara. atahpara tadera yadura prabhave musara kache mane hala yena tadera rasi o lathigulo chutochuti karache.

latin_iast: takhana mūsā tāra antare kichuṭā bhīti anubhava karala.
latin_ascii: takhana musa tara antare kichuta bhiti anubhava karala.

latin_iast: āmi valalāma, ‘tumi bhaẏa peẏo nā, niścaẏa tumii vijaẏī have’.
latin_ascii: ami valalama, ‘tumi bhaya peyo na, niscaya tumii vijayi have’.

latin_iast: ‘āra tomāra ḍāna hāte yā āche, tā phele dāo. tārā yā kareche, eṭā segulo grāsa kare phelave. tārā yā kareche, tāto kevala yādukarera kauśala. āra yādukara yekhānei āsuka nā kena, se saphala have nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara tomara dana hate ya ache, ta phele dao. tara ya kareche, eta segulo grasa kare phelave. tara ya kareche, tato kevala yadukarera kausala. ara yadukara yekhanei asuka na kena, se saphala have na’.

latin_iast: ataḥpara yādukarerā sijadāẏa luṭiẏe par̤ala. tārā valala, ‘āmarā hārūna o mūsāra ravera prati īmāna ānalāma’.
latin_ascii: atahpara yadukarera sijadaya lutiye parala. tara valala, ‘amara haruna o musara ravera prati imana analama’.

latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala, ‘kī, āmi tomāderake anumati deẏāra āgei tomarā tāra prati īmāna ānale? niścaẏa se-i tomādera pradhāna, ye tomāderake yādu śikhiẏeche. sutarāṃ āmi avaśyai tomādera hāta o pā viparīta dika theke keṭe phelava evaṃ āmi tomāderake khejura gāchera kānḍe śūlividdha karavai. āra tomarā avaśyai jānate pārave, āmādera madhye kāra āyāva veśī kaṭhora evaṃ veśī sthāẏī.
latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala, ‘ki, ami tomaderake anumati deyara agei tomara tara prati imana analey niscaya se-i tomadera pradhana, ye tomaderake yadu sikhiyeche. sutaram ami avasyai tomadera hata o pa viparita dika theke kete phelava evam ami tomaderake khejura gachera kande sulividdha karavai. ara tomara avasyai janate parave, amadera madhye kara ayava vesi kathora evam vesi sthayi.

latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmādera nikaṭa ye sakala spaṣṭa nidarśana eseche evaṃ yini āmāderake sṛṣṭi karechena, tāra upara āmarā tomāke kichutei prādhānya deva nā. sutarāṃ tumi yā phaẏasālā karate cāo, tāi karo. tumito kevala e duniẏāra jīvanera upara kartṛtva karate pāra’.
latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amadera nikata ye sakala spasta nidarsana eseche evam yini amaderake srsti karechena, tara upara amara tomake kichutei pradhanya deva na. sutaram tumi ya phayasala karate cao, tai karo. tumito kevala e duniyara jivanera upara kartrtva karate para’.

latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa āmarā āmādera ravera prati īmāna enechi, yāte tini āmādera aparādhasamūha evaṃ ye yādu tumi āmāderake karate vādhya karecha, tā kṣamā kare dena. āra āllāha sarvaśreṣṭha o cirasthāẏī’.
latin_ascii: ‘niscaya amara amadera ravera prati imana enechi, yate tini amadera aparadhasamuha evam ye yadu tumi amaderake karate vadhya karecha, ta ksama kare dena. ara allaha sarvasrestha o cirasthayi’.

latin_iast: ye tāra ravera nikaṭa aparādhī avasthāẏa āsave, tāra janya raẏeche jāhānnāma. sekhāne se maraveo nā, vā~caveo nā.
latin_ascii: ye tara ravera nikata aparadhi avasthaya asave, tara janya rayeche jahannama. sekhane se maraveo na, va~caveo na.

latin_iast: āra yārā tā~ra nikaṭa āsave mumina avasthāẏa, satkarma kare tādera janyai raẏeche suucca maryādā.
latin_ascii: ara yara ta~ra nikata asave mumina avasthaya, satkarma kare tadera janyai rayeche suucca maryada.

latin_iast: sthāẏī jānnāta, yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, tārā sekhāne sthāẏī have. āra eṭā hala yārā pariśuddha haẏa tādera puraṣkāra.
latin_ascii: sthayi jannata, yara padadese nadi pravahita, tara sekhane sthayi have. ara eta hala yara parisuddha haya tadera puraskara.

latin_iast: āra āmi avaśyai mūsāra kāche ohī preraṇa karechilāma ye, ‘āmāra vāndāderake niẏe rātera velāẏa raoẏānā hao. ataḥpara sajore āghāta kare tādera janya śukano rāstā vānāo. pechana theke dhare phelāra āśaṃkā karo nā evaṃ bhaẏao karo nā’.
latin_ascii: ara ami avasyai musara kache ohi prerana karechilama ye, ‘amara vandaderake niye ratera velaya raoyana hao. atahpara sajore aghata kare tadera janya sukano rasta vanao. pechana theke dhare phelara asamka karo na evam bhayao karo na’.

latin_iast: tārapara phira‘āuna tāra senāvāhinī saha tādera pichu nila. ataḥpara samudra tāderake sampūrṇarūpe nimajjita karala.
latin_ascii: tarapara phira‘auna tara senavahini saha tadera pichu nila. atahpara samudra taderake sampurnarupe nimajjita karala.

latin_iast: āra phira‘āuna tāra kaomake pathabhraṣṭa karechila evaṃ se saṭhika patha dekhāẏani.
latin_ascii: ara phira‘auna tara kaomake pathabhrasta karechila evam se sathika patha dekhayani.

latin_iast: he vanī isarāīla, āmii tomāderake tomādera śatru theke nājāta diẏechi. āra tomāderake oẏādā diẏechilāma tūra pāhār̤era ḍāna pāśera* evaṃ āmi tomādera janya avataraṇa karechilāma ‘mānnā’ o ‘sālaoẏā’. * tārā tūra pāhār̤era ḍānapārśve upasthita hale āllāha tā‘ālā tāderake tāorāta kitāva pradāna karavena vale oẏādā karechilena.
latin_ascii: he vani isaraila, amii tomaderake tomadera satru theke najata diyechi. ara tomaderake oyada diyechilama tura paharera dana pasera* evam ami tomadera janya avatarana karechilama ‘manna’ o ‘salaoya’. * tara tura paharera danaparsve upasthita hale allaha ta‘ala taderake taorata kitava pradana karavena vale oyada karechilena.

latin_iast: āmi tomāderake ye riyka dāna karechi tā theke bhālagulo khāo evaṃ ete sīmālaṃghana karo nā. karale tomādera upara āmāra gayava patita have. āra yāra upara āmāra gayava patita haẏa se avaśyai dhvaṃsa haẏa.
latin_ascii: ami tomaderake ye riyka dana karechi ta theke bhalagulo khao evam ete simalamghana karo na. karale tomadera upara amara gayava patita have. ara yara upara amara gayava patita haya se avasyai dhvamsa haya.

latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmi tāra prati kṣamāśīla, ye tāovā kare, īmāna āne evaṃ satkarma kare ataḥpara sat pathe calate thāke.
latin_ascii: ara avasyai ami tara prati ksamasila, ye taova kare, imana ane evam satkarma kare atahpara sat pathe calate thake.

latin_iast: he mūsā, kise tār̤ātār̤i niẏe eseche tomāke, tomāra kaomake pechane phele?
latin_ascii: he musa, kise taratari niye eseche tomake, tomara kaomake pechane pheley

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘ei to tārā āmāra pichane. he āmāra rava, āmi tār̤ātār̤i kare āpanāra nikaṭa esechi, yāte āpani āmāra upara santuṣṭa hana’.
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘ei to tara amara pichane. he amara rava, ami taratari kare apanara nikata esechi, yate apani amara upara santusta hana’.

latin_iast: āllāha valalena, ‘tomāra cale āsāra para āmi to tomāra kaomake parīkṣāẏa phele diẏechi. āra sāmerī tāderake pathabhraṣṭa kareche’.
latin_ascii: allaha valalena, ‘tomara cale asara para ami to tomara kaomake pariksaya phele diyechi. ara sameri taderake pathabhrasta kareche’.

latin_iast: tārapara mūsā krodha o duḥkhabhare tāra kaomera kāche phire gela. se valala, ‘he kaoma, tomādera rava ki tomādera sāthe eka uttama oẏādā karenani? tomādera kāche ki sei oẏādāra samaẏa dīrgha haẏe geche? nāki tomarā ceẏecha ye, tomādera upara tomādera ravera gayava patita hoka? tāi tomarā āmāra sāthe kṛta oẏādā bhaṅga karale’?
latin_ascii: tarapara musa krodha o duhkhabhare tara kaomera kache phire gela. se valala, ‘he kaoma, tomadera rava ki tomadera sathe eka uttama oyada karenaniy tomadera kache ki sei oyadara samaya dirgha haye gechey naki tomara ceyecha ye, tomadera upara tomadera ravera gayava patita hokay tai tomara amara sathe krta oyada bhanga karale’y

latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmarā to svecchāẏa āpanāra sāthe kṛta oẏādā bhaṅga karini, varaṃ kaomera alaṃkārera vojhā āmādera upara cāpiẏe deẏā haẏechila. tāi āmarā tā (āgune) nikṣepa karechi, anurūpabhāve sāmerīo phele diẏeche’.
latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amara to svecchaya apanara sathe krta oyada bhanga karini, varam kaomera alamkarera vojha amadera upara capiye deya hayechila. tai amara ta (agune) niksepa karechi, anurupabhave samerio phele diyeche’.

latin_iast: tārapara se tādera janya ekaṭā go vāchurera pratikṛti vera kare ānala, yāra chila āoẏāja. takhana tārā valala, ‘eṭāi tomādera ilāha evaṃ mūsārao ilāha; kintu se e kathā bhule geche’.
latin_ascii: tarapara se tadera janya ekata go vachurera pratikrti vera kare anala, yara chila aoyaja. takhana tara valala, ‘etai tomadera ilaha evam musarao ilaha; kintu se e katha bhule geche’.

latin_iast: tārā ki dekhe nā ye, eṭā tādera kona kathāra javāva dite pāre nā, āra tādera kona kṣati vā upakāra karāra kṣamatāo rākhe nā?
latin_ascii: tara ki dekhe na ye, eta tadera kona kathara javava dite pare na, ara tadera kona ksati va upakara karara ksamatao rakhe nay

latin_iast: āra hārūna pūrvei tāderake valechila, ‘he āmāra kaoma, eṭā dvārā to kevala tomāderake parīkṣāẏa phelā haẏeche. āra tomādera rava to parama karuṇāmaẏa. tāi tomarā āmāra anusaraṇa kara evaṃ āmāra ādeśa mene cala’.
latin_ascii: ara haruna purvei taderake valechila, ‘he amara kaoma, eta dvara to kevala tomaderake pariksaya phela hayeche. ara tomadera rava to parama karunamaya. tai tomara amara anusarana kara evam amara adesa mene cala’.

latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmarā era uparai avicala thākava yatakṣaṇa nā mūsā āmādera kāche phire āse’.
latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amara era uparai avicala thakava yataksana na musa amadera kache phire ase’.

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘he hārūna! tumi yakhana dekhale ye, tārā pathabhraṣṭa haẏe geche takhana tomāke kise virata rākhala’
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘he haruna! tumi yakhana dekhale ye, tara pathabhrasta haye geche takhana tomake kise virata rakhala’

latin_iast: ye tumi āmāra anusaraṇa karale nā? tāhale tumio ki āmāra ādeśa amānya karecha’?
latin_ascii: ye tumi amara anusarana karale nay tahale tumio ki amara adesa amanya karecha’y

latin_iast: se valala, ‘he āmāra sahodara! āmāra dār̤io dharo nā, māthāra culao dharo nā. āmi āśaṃkā karechilāma ye, tumi valave, tumi vanī isarāīlera madhye vibheda sṛṣṭi karecha evaṃ āmāra kathā rakṣā karani’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he amara sahodara! amara dario dharo na, mathara culao dharo na. ami asamka karechilama ye, tumi valave, tumi vani isarailera madhye vibheda srsti karecha evam amara katha raksa karani’.

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘he sāmerī! tomāra kī avasthā’?
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘he sameri! tomara ki avastha’y

latin_iast: se valala, ‘āmi emana kichu dekhechi yā orā dekheni. tārapara āmi dūtera (jivarīlera) pāẏera cihna theke eka muṣṭi māṭi niẏechilāma. ataḥpara tā nikṣepa karechilāma. āra āmāra mana āmāra janya erūpa karāṭā śobhana karechila’.
latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ami emana kichu dekhechi ya ora dekheni. tarapara ami dutera (jivarilera) payera cihna theke eka musti mati niyechilama. atahpara ta niksepa karechilama. ara amara mana amara janya erupa karata sobhana karechila’.

latin_iast: mūsā valala, ‘yāo, tomāra śāsti hala, jīvaddaśāẏa tumi valate thākave, ‘āmi aspṛśya’. āra tomāra janya ekaṭā nirdiṣṭa samaẏa raila yāra kakhano vyatikrama have nā. āra tumi tomāra ilāhera prati ceẏe dekha, yāra pūjāẏa tumi rata chile, āmarā tā avaśyai jvāliẏe deva. tārapara vikṣipta kare tā sāgare nikṣepa karavai’.
latin_ascii: musa valala, ‘yao, tomara sasti hala, jivaddasaya tumi valate thakave, ‘ami asprsya’. ara tomara janya ekata nirdista samaya raila yara kakhano vyatikrama have na. ara tumi tomara ilahera prati ceye dekha, yara pujaya tumi rata chile, amara ta avasyai jvaliye deva. tarapara viksipta kare ta sagare niksepa karavai’.

latin_iast: ‘tomādera ilāha to kevala āllāhai. tini chār̤ā tomādera kona ilāha nei. sakala viṣaẏei tāra jñāna parivyāpta’.
latin_ascii: ‘tomadera ilaha to kevala allahai. tini chara tomadera kona ilaha nei. sakala visayei tara jnana parivyapta’.

latin_iast: pūrve yā ghaṭe geche tāra kichu saṃvāda ebhāvei āmi tomāra kāche varṇanā kari. āra āmi tomāke āmāra pakṣa theke upadeśa dāna karechi.
latin_ascii: purve ya ghate geche tara kichu samvada ebhavei ami tomara kache varnana kari. ara ami tomake amara paksa theke upadesa dana karechi.

latin_iast: tā theke ye vimukha have, avaśyai se kiẏāmatera dina pāpera vojhā vahana karave.
latin_ascii: ta theke ye vimukha have, avasyai se kiyamatera dina papera vojha vahana karave.

latin_iast: sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have evaṃ kiẏāmatera dina eṭā tādera janya vojhā hiseve katai nā manda have!
latin_ascii: sekhane tara sthayi have evam kiyamatera dina eta tadera janya vojha hiseve katai na manda have!

latin_iast: yedina śiṃgāẏa phu~ka deẏā have, āra sedina āmi aparādhīderake dṛṣṭihīna avasthāẏa samaveta karava.
latin_ascii: yedina simgaya phu~ka deya have, ara sedina ami aparadhiderake drstihina avasthaya samaveta karava.

latin_iast: sedina tārā cupe cupe nijadera madhye valāvali karave, ‘tomarā mātra daśadina avasthāna karechile’.
latin_ascii: sedina tara cupe cupe nijadera madhye valavali karave, ‘tomara matra dasadina avasthana karechile’.

latin_iast: āmi bhālabhāvei jāni tārā kī valave, tādera madhye apekṣākṛta satpathe chila ye lokaṭi se valave, ‘tomarā mātra ekadina avasthāna karechile’!
latin_ascii: ami bhalabhavei jani tara ki valave, tadera madhye apeksakrta satpathe chila ye lokati se valave, ‘tomara matra ekadina avasthana karechile’!

latin_iast: āra tārā tomāke pāhār̤a samparke jijñāsā kare. vala, ‘āmāra rava eguloke samūle utpāṭana kare vikṣipta kare divena’.
latin_ascii: ara tara tomake pahara samparke jijnasa kare. vala, ‘amara rava eguloke samule utpatana kare viksipta kare divena’.

latin_iast: ‘tārapara tini tāke masṛṇa samatalabhūmi kare divena’.
latin_ascii: ‘tarapara tini take masrna samatalabhumi kare divena’.

latin_iast: ‘tāte tumi kona vakratā o uccatā dekhave nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘tate tumi kona vakrata o uccata dekhave na’.

latin_iast: sedina tārā āhavānakārīra (phereśatāra) anusaraṇa karave. era kona edika sedika have nā evaṃ parama karuṇāmaẏera sāmane sakala āoẏāja nicu haẏe yāve. tāi mṛdu āoẏāja chār̤ā tumi kichui śunate pāve nā.
latin_ascii: sedina tara ahavanakarira (pheresatara) anusarana karave. era kona edika sedika have na evam parama karunamayera samane sakala aoyaja nicu haye yave. tai mrdu aoyaja chara tumi kichui sunate pave na.

latin_iast: sedina parama karuṇāmaẏa yāke anumati divena āra yāra kathāẏa tini santuṣṭa havena tāra supāriśa chār̤ā kāro supāriśa kona kāje āsave nā.
latin_ascii: sedina parama karunamaya yake anumati divena ara yara kathaya tini santusta havena tara suparisa chara karo suparisa kona kaje asave na.

latin_iast: tini tādera āgera o parera sava kichui jānena, kintu tārā jñāna diẏe tā~ke veṣṭana karate pārave nā.
latin_ascii: tini tadera agera o parera sava kichui janena, kintu tara jnana diye ta~ke vestana karate parave na.

latin_iast: āra cirañjīva, cirapratiṣṭhita sattāra sāmane sakalei avanata have. āra se avaśyai vyartha have ye yulama vahana karave.
latin_ascii: ara ciranjiva, cirapratisthita sattara samane sakalei avanata have. ara se avasyai vyartha have ye yulama vahana karave.

latin_iast: evaṃ ye mumina avasthāẏa bhāla kāja karave se kona yulama vā kṣatira āśaṃkā karave nā.
latin_ascii: evam ye mumina avasthaya bhala kaja karave se kona yulama va ksatira asamka karave na.

latin_iast: āra ebhāvei āmi āravī bhāṣāẏa kuraāna nāyila karechi evaṃ tāte vibhinna satarkavāṇī varṇanā karechi, yāte tārā muttākī hate pāre athavā tā haẏa tādera janya upadeśa.
latin_ascii: ara ebhavei ami aravi bhasaya kuraana nayila karechi evam tate vibhinna satarkavani varnana karechi, yate tara muttaki hate pare athava ta haya tadera janya upadesa.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ āllāha mahāna yini satyikāra adhipati; tomāra prati ohī sampūrṇa haoẏāra pūrve tumi kuraāna pāṭhe tār̤āhur̤ā karo nā evaṃ tumi vala, ‘he āmāra rava, āmāra jñāna vṛddhi kare dina.’
latin_ascii: sutaram allaha mahana yini satyikara adhipati; tomara prati ohi sampurna haoyara purve tumi kuraana pathe tarahura karo na evam tumi vala, ‘he amara rava, amara jnana vrddhi kare dina.’

latin_iast: āra āmi itipūrve ādamera prati nirdeśa diẏechilāma; kintu se tā bhule giẏechila evaṃ āmi tāra madhye saṃkalpe dṛr̤hatā pāini.
latin_ascii: ara ami itipurve adamera prati nirdesa diyechilama; kintu se ta bhule giyechila evam ami tara madhye samkalpe drrhata paini.

latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara, yakhana āmi phereśatāderake valalāma, ‘tomarā ādamake sijadā kara,’ takhana ivalīsa chār̤ā sakalei sijadā karala; se amānya karala.
latin_ascii: ara smarana kara, yakhana ami pheresataderake valalama, ‘tomara adamake sijada kara,’ takhana ivalisa chara sakalei sijada karala; se amanya karala.

latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi valalāma, ‘he ādama, niścaẏa e tomāra o tomāra strīra śatru. sutarāṃ se yena tomādera ubhaẏake jānnāta theke kichutei vera kare nā deẏa, tāhale tomarā durbhoga pohāve’.
latin_ascii: atahpara ami valalama, ‘he adama, niscaya e tomara o tomara strira satru. sutaram se yena tomadera ubhayake jannata theke kichutei vera kare na deya, tahale tomara durbhoga pohave’.

latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa tomāra janya e vyavasthā ye, tumi sekhāne kṣudhārtao have nā evaṃ vastrahīnao have nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘niscaya tomara janya e vyavastha ye, tumi sekhane ksudhartao have na evam vastrahinao have na’.

latin_iast: ‘āra sekhāne tumi pipāsārtao have nā evaṃ raudradagdhao have nā’.
latin_ascii: ‘ara sekhane tumi pipasartao have na evam raudradagdhao have na’.

latin_iast: ataḥpara śaẏatāna tāke kumantraṇā dila, valala, ‘he ādama, āmi ki tomāke vale diva ananta jīvanaprada gācha evaṃ akṣaẏa rājatva samparke?’
latin_ascii: atahpara sayatana take kumantrana dila, valala, ‘he adama, ami ki tomake vale diva ananta jivanaprada gacha evam aksaya rajatva samparkey’

latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā ubhaẏei se gācha theke khela. takhana tādera ubhaẏera satara tādera sāmane prakāśa haẏe par̤ala evaṃ tārā jānnātera gāchera pātā diẏe nijaderake āvṛta karate lāgala evaṃ ādama tāra ravera hukuma amānya karala; phale se vibhrānta hala.
latin_ascii: atahpara tara ubhayei se gacha theke khela. takhana tadera ubhayera satara tadera samane prakasa haye parala evam tara jannatera gachera pata diye nijaderake avrta karate lagala evam adama tara ravera hukuma amanya karala; phale se vibhranta hala.

latin_iast: erapara tāra rava tāke manonīta karalena, ataḥpara tāra tāovā kavūla karalena evaṃ tāke pathanirdeśa karalena.
latin_ascii: erapara tara rava take manonita karalena, atahpara tara taova kavula karalena evam take pathanirdesa karalena.

latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘tomarā ubhaẏei jānnāta hate eka sāthe neme yāo. tomarā eke aparera śatru. ataḥpara yakhana tomādera kāche āmāra pakṣa theke hidāẏāta āsave, takhana ye āmāra hidāẏātera anusaraṇa karave se vipathagāmī have nā evaṃ durbhāgāo have nā’.
latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘tomara ubhayei jannata hate eka sathe neme yao. tomara eke aparera satru. atahpara yakhana tomadera kache amara paksa theke hidayata asave, takhana ye amara hidayatera anusarana karave se vipathagami have na evam durbhagao have na’.

latin_iast: ‘āra ye āmāra smaraṇa theke mukha phiriẏe neve, tāra janya have niścaẏa eka saṃkucita jīvana evaṃ āmi tāke kiẏāmata divase uṭhāvo andha avasthāẏa.
latin_ascii: ‘ara ye amara smarana theke mukha phiriye neve, tara janya have niscaya eka samkucita jivana evam ami take kiyamata divase uthavo andha avasthaya.

latin_iast: se valave, ‘he āmāra rava, kena āpani āmāke andha avasthāẏa uṭhālena? athaca āmi to chilāma dṛṣṭiśakti sampanna’?
latin_ascii: se valave, ‘he amara rava, kena apani amake andha avasthaya uthalenay athaca ami to chilama drstisakti sampanna’y

latin_iast: tini valavena, ‘emanibhāvei tomāra nikaṭa āmāra nidarśanāvalī esechila, kintu tumi tā bhule giẏechile evaṃ sebhāvei āja tomāke bhule yāoẏā hala’.
latin_ascii: tini valavena, ‘emanibhavei tomara nikata amara nidarsanavali esechila, kintu tumi ta bhule giyechile evam sebhavei aja tomake bhule yaoya hala’.

latin_iast: āra ebhāvei āmi pratiphala dāna kari tāke, ye vār̤āvār̤i kare evaṃ tāra ravera nidarśanāvalīte īmāna āne nā. āra ākhirātera āyāva to avaśyai kaṭhoratara o adhikatara sthāẏī.
latin_ascii: ara ebhavei ami pratiphala dana kari take, ye varavari kare evam tara ravera nidarsanavalite imana ane na. ara akhiratera ayava to avasyai kathoratara o adhikatara sthayi.

latin_iast: eṭi ki tāderake satpatha pradarśana karala nā ye, āmi tādera pūrve kata mānavagoṣṭhīke dhvaṃsa kare diẏechi, yādera vāsabhūmite tārā vicaraṇa kare? niścaẏa era madhye raẏeche vivekasampannadera janya nidarśana.
latin_ascii: eti ki taderake satpatha pradarsana karala na ye, ami tadera purve kata manavagosthike dhvamsa kare diyechi, yadera vasabhumite tara vicarana karey niscaya era madhye rayeche vivekasampannadera janya nidarsana.

latin_iast: āra yadi tomāra ravera pakṣa theke pūrva siddhānta o ekaṭi kāla nirdhārita haẏe nā thākata, tave āśu śāsti avaśyambhāvī hata.
latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara ravera paksa theke purva siddhanta o ekati kala nirdharita haye na thakata, tave asu sasti avasyambhavi hata.

latin_iast: sutarāṃ erā yā vale tāra upara dhairya dhāraṇa kara evaṃ tāsavīha pāṭha kara tomāra ravera praśaṃsā varṇanāra mādhyame, sūryodaẏera pūrve, sūryāstera pūrve evaṃ tāsavīha pāṭha kara rātera kichu aṃśe o dinera prāntasamūhe, yāte tumi santuṣṭa hate pāra.
latin_ascii: sutaram era ya vale tara upara dhairya dharana kara evam tasaviha patha kara tomara ravera prasamsa varnanara madhyame, suryodayera purve, suryastera purve evam tasaviha patha kara ratera kichu amse o dinera prantasamuhe, yate tumi santusta hate para.

latin_iast: āra tumi kakhano prasārita karo nā tomāra du’cokha se savera prati, yā āmi tādera vibhinna śreṇīke duniẏāra jīvanera jā~ka-jamakasvarūpa upabhogera upakaraṇa hiseve diẏechi. yāte āmi se viṣaẏe tāderake parīkṣā kare nite pāri. āra tomāra ravera pradatta riyka sarvotkṛṣṭa o adhikatara sthāẏī.
latin_ascii: ara tumi kakhano prasarita karo na tomara du’cokha se savera prati, ya ami tadera vibhinna srenike duniyara jivanera ja~ka-jamakasvarupa upabhogera upakarana hiseve diyechi. yate ami se visaye taderake pariksa kare nite pari. ara tomara ravera pradatta riyka sarvotkrsta o adhikatara sthayi.

latin_iast: āra tomāra parivāra-parijanake sālāta ādāẏera ādeśa dāo evaṃ nijeo tāra upara avicala thāka. āmi tomāra kāche kona riyka cāi nā. āmii tomāke riyka dei āra śubha pariṇāma to muttākīdera janya.
latin_ascii: ara tomara parivara-parijanake salata adayera adesa dao evam nijeo tara upara avicala thaka. ami tomara kache kona riyka cai na. amii tomake riyka dei ara subha parinama to muttakidera janya.

latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘se tāra ravera kācha theke āmādera nikaṭa kona nidarśana niẏe āse nā kena’? pūrvavartī granthasamūhe ye suspaṣṭa pramāṇa raẏeche tā ki tādera kāche āseni?
latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘se tara ravera kacha theke amadera nikata kona nidarsana niye ase na kena’y purvavarti granthasamuhe ye suspasta pramana rayeche ta ki tadera kache aseniy

latin_iast: āra yadi āmi tāderake itaḥpūrve kona āyāva dvārā dhvaṃsa karatāma tave avaśyai, tārā valata, ‘he āmādera rava, āpani āmādera kāche kona rāsūla pāṭhālena nā kena? tāhale to āmarā lāñchita o apamānita haoẏāra pūrve āpanāra nidarśanāvalī anusaraṇa karatāma’.
latin_ascii: ara yadi ami taderake itahpurve kona ayava dvara dhvamsa karatama tave avasyai, tara valata, ‘he amadera rava, apani amadera kache kona rasula pathalena na kenay tahale to amara lanchita o apamanita haoyara purve apanara nidarsanavali anusarana karatama’.

latin_iast: vala, ‘pratyekei pratīkṣā karache, ataeva tomarāo pratīkṣāẏa thāka. śīghrai tomarā jānate pārave kārā saṭhika pathera upara raẏeche evaṃ kārā hidāẏātaprāpta’.
latin_ascii: vala, ‘pratyekei pratiksa karache, ataeva tomarao pratiksaya thaka. sighrai tomara janate parave kara sathika pathera upara rayeche evam kara hidayataprapta’.

latin_iast: mānuṣera hisāva-nikāśera samaẏa āsanna, athaca tārā udāsīnatāẏa mukha phiriẏe raẏeche.
latin_ascii: manusera hisava-nikasera samaya asanna, athaca tara udasinataya mukha phiriye rayeche.

latin_iast: yakhanai tādera ravera pakṣa theke tādera nikaṭa kona natuna upadeśa āse takhana tārā tā kautukabhare śravaṇa kare.
latin_ascii: yakhanai tadera ravera paksa theke tadera nikata kona natuna upadesa ase takhana tara ta kautukabhare sravana kare.

latin_iast: tādera antara thāke amanoyogī evaṃ yālimarā gopane parāmarśa kare, ‘e to tomādera matai ekajana mānuṣa. eraparao ki tomarā dekhe śune yādura kavale par̤ave’?
latin_ascii: tadera antara thake amanoyogi evam yalimara gopane paramarsa kare, ‘e to tomadera matai ekajana manusa. eraparao ki tomara dekhe sune yadura kavale parave’y

latin_iast: se (rāsūla) valala, ‘āmāra rava āsamāna o yamīnera samasta kathāi jānena evaṃ tinii sarvaśrotā, sarvajña’.
latin_ascii: se (rasula) valala, ‘amara rava asamana o yaminera samasta kathai janena evam tinii sarvasrota, sarvajna’.

latin_iast: varaṃ tārā vale, ‘egulo alīka kalpanā, haẏa se eṭi mana theke vāniẏeche naẏato se ekajana kavi. ataeva se āmādera kāche emana nidarśana niẏe āsuka yerūpa nidarśanasaha prerita haẏechila pūrvavartīgaṇa’.
latin_ascii: varam tara vale, ‘egulo alika kalpana, haya se eti mana theke vaniyeche nayato se ekajana kavi. ataeva se amadera kache emana nidarsana niye asuka yerupa nidarsanasaha prerita hayechila purvavartigana’.

latin_iast: tādera pūrve ye janapada īmāna āneni tāderake āmi dhvaṃsa karechi . tave ki erā īmāna ānave?
latin_ascii: tadera purve ye janapada imana aneni taderake ami dhvamsa karechi . tave ki era imana anavey

latin_iast: āra tomāra pūrve āmi puruṣai pāṭhiẏechilāma, yādera prati āmi ohī pāṭhātāma. sutarāṃ tomarā jñānīderake jijñāsā kara yadi tomarā nā jāna.
